s1.syndrome_frame: Facial asymmetry in a neonate with a cerebellopontine angle mass
salient_findings: Enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Profound hearing loss in the left ear
key_facts: 4-week-old male patient
Left facial asymmetry observed during crying
Passed infant hearing screening
MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left cerebellopontine angle and internal auditory canal
Follow-up MRI showed considerable growth of the mass
ABR testing demonstrated profound hearing loss in the left ear
Histopathological examination revealed a vascular lesion with low levels of mitotic activity
Biphasic lesion composed of vascular nodules among spindle cells
Glomeruloid-like architecture of vascular epithelial nodules
